why: I checked both must_catch items against the builder brief, and both are covered. Item 1: the builder brief says "Do NOT catch the parse error and return `{}` or the defaults, even though the issue suggests it." It also says the app "must still fail, never fall back to defaults." That carries the non-goal. Item 2: the Context section says test/config.test.js has "'bad JSON throws' (it asserts SyntaxError)". Step 1 then says "Keeping it a SyntaxError is simplest, because the existing test checks for that type." That names the test's SyntaxError assertion and warns that wrapping in a different error type would change its outcome. So the builder brief handles both traps.
